title: Operating System Patch State event (patch-rollout discovery telemetry for the operator's patch-management ledger)
summary: OCSF Operating System Patch State events the operator's patch-management surface emits at each patch-application observation. Carries the per-patch identity (KB / advisory article list), the applied-state activity, and the observation timestamp so the kpi.patch_rollout_success_rate@v1 and kri.patch_rollout_overdue_exposure@v1 indicators can read rollout outcome and overdue-exposure cardinality off a single OCSF class shape. Vendor-neutral binding: the catalog entry pins the OCSF Operating System Patch State class (uid 5004), not a vendor-specific patch-management API object.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Discovery category — Operating System Patch State class (uid 5004)
